newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Templeton adds two new unit trusts in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Templeton adds two new unit trusts in Singapore.

text.p: Templeton Asset Management Ltd said on Monday it was launching two new sub-funds to be added to its Singapore umbrella unit trust, Templeton Investment Funds.

The two funds are the China Fund, investing in 'Greater China' -- China, Hong Kong and Taiwan -- and the Asian Smaller Companies Fund, which will invest in Asian companies with a market capitalisation not exceeding US$500 million.
The Singapore trusts will act as feeders into previously established Templeton unit trusts.

Stewart Aldcroft, Marketing and Sales Director for Asia of Templeton Franklin Investment Services told a news conference, "It (Greater China) is one of the greatest areas for investments over the next five years."
Currently, the China Fund has 88 percent of its proceeds invested in equities with the balance in cash. Its largest holding is in Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd.
The largest holding in the Asian Smaller Companies Fund is in United Motor Lanka.
